preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of people n must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of steel chains m must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**4 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each fridge weight a_i must be between 0 and 10000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if m > n * (n - 1) // 2 else True
postconditions.description: If m exceeds the maximum number of unique chains, output -1.

postconditions.expression: c == sum(a[u-1] + a[v-1] for u, v in chains)
postconditions.description: The total cost c must equal the sum of the weights of the fridges connected by the chains.
The number of chains output must be exactly m.
